units.source_text: 惟光恳求源氏太政大臣：“宫中典侍有空额，但愿赐小女为典侍。”

en.t: Koremitsu earnestly begged Genji, the Chancellor: "There is a vacancy for a Naishi in the palace; please allow my daughter to be appointed to it."

units.source_text: 源氏答应为他设法。

en.t: Genji agreed to try to arrange it for him.

units.source_text: 夕雾闻知此事，大失所望。

en.t: When Yugiri heard of this, he was deeply disappointed.

units.source_text: 他想：“如果我的年龄不是这样小，官位不是这样低，我可请得这女子。

en.t: He thought, "If I were not so young and my rank were not so low, I could ask for this girl myself.

units.source_text: 现在连我的心事也无法教她知道，真伤心啊！”

en.t: As it is, I cannot even let her know what is in my heart. How sad it is!"

units.source_text: 他对这五节舞姬的相思虽不甚苦，但添上了对云居雁的相思，终不免时时流泪。

en.t: His longing for this Gosechi dancer was not especially painful, but added to his longing for Kumoi no Kari, it still made him shed tears from time to time.

units.source_text: 这五节舞姬的哥哥，是个殿上童子，常常到夕雾这里来侍候他。

en.t: This Gosechi dancer's elder brother was a palace page, and he often came to attend on Yugiri.

units.source_text: 有一次，夕雾特别亲昵地和他谈话，问道：“你家那个五节舞姬几时进宫？”

en.t: One day, Yugiri spoke to him with unusual familiarity and asked, "When will that Gosechi dancer in your family enter the palace?"

units.source_text: 童子答道：“听说年前要进宫的。”

en.t: The boy answered, "I hear she is to enter the palace before the end of the year."

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“她的相貌长得真美丽，我很爱她呢。

en.t: Yugiri said, "Her looks are truly beautiful, and I love her dearly.

units.source_text: 你能常常见她，我真羡慕你啊！

en.t: You can see her often; I truly envy you!

units.source_text: 可否设法让我再见一次？”

en.t: Could you somehow let me see her once more?"

units.source_text: 童子答道：“这怎么使得！

en.t: The boy replied, "How could that possibly be allowed!

units.source_text: 我也不能随便见她，父亲说兄弟是男子，不得与女子接近。

en.t: Even I cannot see her freely; my father says that brothers are men too and must not go near women.

units.source_text: 何况你们，怎么能见她呢！”

en.t: All the more, how could people like you see her!"

units.source_text: 夕雾说：“那么，你总得给我送封信去。”

en.t: Yugiri said, "Then at least you must deliver a letter for me."

units.source_text: 便把信交给他。

en.t: Then he handed the letter to him.

units.source_text: 童子因为父亲早有警诫：不许干此种事情，所以面有难色。

en.t: Because his father had already warned him not to do such things, the boy looked troubled.

units.source_text: 但夕雾强要他接受。

en.t: But Yugiri forced him to accept it.

units.source_text: 他不好意思坚拒，只得拿了信回家去。

en.t: Too embarrassed to refuse firmly, he had no choice but to take the letter and go home.

units.source_text: 那五节舞姬年纪虽小，而情窦已开，得了信很欢喜。

en.t: Although the Gosechi dancer was still young, her feelings of love had already awakened, and she was delighted to receive the letter.

units.source_text: 但见用的是精美的绿色双重笺；笔迹虽然还很稚气，显见将来大有前途。

en.t: She saw that it was written on fine double-layered green paper; although the handwriting was still childish, it clearly showed great promise for the future.

units.source_text: 那书体非常可爱。

en.t: The style of the writing was extremely charming.

units.source_text: 信中有诗云：

en.t: The letter contained a poem that said:
